description: Security and persistence fixes for web/index.html, web/viewer.html and web/lib: flagless iframe sandbox plus injected Content-Security-Policy, blob:-based offline replay replacing the live <base href>, escaping of crawled URLs/titles in innerHTML, generated web/profiles.bundle.js from profiles/*.json via a stdlib script, OpfsStreamer wired into WarcWriter, localStorage checkpoint/resume of queue and visited set with a resume banner, and ?profile= handling for the launcher hand-off; plus stdlib-only tests.
